definitions.gloss: another day; a different day; an alternative date
definitions.explanation: A day other than the one originally planned or discussed. Often used when rescheduling appointments or events.

examples.japanese: {別|べつ}{日|じつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧。
examples.english: To change to a different day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}ければ→悪い：00908_warui⟧{別|べつ}{日|じつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{構|かま}いません。
examples.english: If it's not convenient, another day is fine too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨天|うてん}→雨天：15325_uten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別|べつ}{日|じつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: In the event of rain, we will postpone to another day.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (different, separate) and {日|じつ} (day). Commonly used in scheduling and business contexts when proposing or requesting an alternative date.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別|べつ}{日|じつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change to another day
- {別|べつ}{日|じつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{延期|えんき}する→延期する：02517_enkisuru⟧: to postpone to another day
- {別|べつ}{日|じつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to set up a different date
- {別|べつ}{日|じつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{可|か}: another day is also acceptable

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後日|ごじつ}→後日：12510_gojitsu⟧: a later day — implies a future date, not just a different one
- ⟦{他|た}→他：03381_ta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: another day — less formal, more conversational
- {改|あらた}めて: on another occasion — used as an adverb, broader than just changing dates
